usedFor: Windsurf is a coding workspace, and “Create Session” starts a session from a prompt with optional settings.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Session” in Windsurf
bestTemplate.why: The action turns a prompt into a session, so work starts without opening the tool.

watchOut: “Create Session” starts from a prompt, so check the prompt says what you want done.
